items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: so I took the band -- I even had Gene Schroeder in that one

ctx.x: That was really your first time back in Chicago since you had left about ten years before - right?

Yes, really to play and it got slowed; ; we got the chance to go to the Ken Club so I took the band -- I even had Gene Schroeder in that one and the Chicago drummer; we went to the Ken Club in an old Packard that I had and we got there and did a hell of a job.
Tell that story about how the Down Beat and other places reported you playing the valve trombone on the Ken Club---
